name: Spiko Amundi Overnight Swap Fund (EUR)
oneLiner: EURSAFO is Spiko's EUR share of the Spiko/Amundi Smart Cash fund, an AMF-authorized UCITS using fully collateralized overnight total-return swaps.
collateral: EUR share class of the Spiko / Amundi Smart Cash fund using fully collateralized total-return swaps with tier-1 bank counterparties and collateral made of liquid financial instruments / money-market fund exposure.
pegMechanism: EUR-denominated NAV-accreting share class; subscriptions and redemptions are KYC-gated through Spiko fund-transfer rails at the published fund NAV.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The EURSAFO share gives proportional ownership of a UCITS securities portfolio. The 1 September 2026 prospectus invests in bonds, equities and money market instruments and transfers portfolio performance through total-return swaps, with a possible unswapped money-market UCITS sleeve. This exact-product holder claim and mixed physical-securities/swap mechanism do not establish direct short-duration Treasury-bill backing. The former tbill assignment is withdrawn under D18; no replacement family or grade is asserted without an exact-product methodology review.

sources.label: Spiko SICAV prospectus published 1 September 2026, SAFO strategy and shareholder rights

proofOfReserves.provider: PricewaterhouseCoopers Audit is the statutory auditor named in the Spiko SICAV prospectus. The linked AMF authorization certificate is not an audit or reserve-to-liability report; no current SAFO-specific financial audit report was verified in the public sources reviewed on 2026-10-01.
